items.title: Cosmos Labs Urges EVM Chains To Halt As Shared Bug Drains Three Networks
items.author: The Defiant Team

metadata.title_en: Cosmos Labs Urges Halt on EVM Chains After Shared Bug Drains Three Networks
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Cosmos Labs has urged validators of affected networks to halt their chains after a shared vulnerability in its Cosmos EVM module drained funds on three blockchains. The bug was quietly patched last week without a security advisory, drawing criticism from the security community.

This incident exposes the systemic risk of shared infrastructure: a single bug in a widely used module can drain multiple chains simultaneously. It also highlights the dangers of silent patching, which can leave downstream networks vulnerable before they can upgrade.

KiiChain lost nearly 150 million KII tokens (worth about $9 million at the time, later dumped for only $1.6 million BUSD), while TAC lost 3 billion TAC tokens (about $7.5 million) from its staking contract. KiiChain's post-mortem says two of the three underlying defects remain unfixed upstream.
metadata.background_en: Cosmos EVM is an open-source Cosmos SDK module that embeds a full Ethereum Virtual Machine into CometBFT-based chains, allowing developers to deploy Solidity contracts and use standard EVM tooling. A 'silent patch model' means security fixes are released publicly without coordinated disclosure, so chains that don't upgrade immediately may be exposed. Four networks using the module — MANTRA, TAC, KiiChain, and Nesa — were affected, with MANTRA and Nesa halting chains without user fund losses.
metadata.community_discussion_en: The original disclosure was branded 'negligent AF' by critics, in line with Cosmos' silent patch policy. KiiChain's post-mortem openly blamed Cosmos Labs' disclosure process, stating that publishing a security fix in the open before privately notifying affected chains 'hands the vulnerability to anyone reading the commit.'
metadata.market_impact_en: The exploit directly affected KII and TAC token markets — KiiChain's drained tokens were dumped for $1.6 million in BUSD, briefly crashing the token's price. The event may increase scrutiny on Cosmos-based chains and their reliance on shared modules, potentially affecting sentiment and liquidity for affected ecosystems, though no directional outcome is implied.
metadata.title_zh: Cosmos Labs 敦促 EVM 链暂停，共享漏洞致三条网络被盗
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Cosmos Labs 敦促受影响网络的验证者暂停其链，因为其 Cosmos EVM 模块中的共享漏洞导致三个区块链上的资金被抽走。该漏洞上周在没有安全公告的情况下被悄然修补，引起了安全界的批评。

这起事件暴露了共享基础设施的系统性风险：一个在广泛使用的模块中的漏洞可能同时导致多条链被抽走资金。它也凸显了静默修补的危险，这种修补方式可能使下游网络在升级前仍然暴露在漏洞中。

KiiChain 损失了近 1.5 亿个 KII 代币（当时价值约 900 万美元，随后仅被抛售为 160 万美元 BUSD），而 TAC 的质押合约中被盗走 30 亿个 TAC 代币（约 750 万美元）。KiiChain 的事后分析报告称，三个根本缺陷中有两个仍在上游未修复。
metadata.background_zh: Cosmos EVM 是一个开源 Cosmos SDK 模块，它将完整的以太坊虚拟机嵌入基于 CometBFT 的链中，允许开发者部署 Solidity 合约并使用标准 EVM 工具。"静默修补模式"意味着安全修复会公开发布而不进行协调披露，因此未立即升级的链可能会受到威胁。使用该模块的四个网络——MANTRA、TAC、KiiChain 和 Nesa——均受到影响，其中 MANTRA 和 Nesa 停止了链但用户资金未受损失。
metadata.community_discussion_zh: 批评者将最初的披露形容为"极其疏忽"，这与 Cosmos 的静默修补政策一致。KiiChain 的事后分析公开指责 Cosmos Labs 的披露流程，称在私下通知受影响的链之前公开发布安全修复，"等于把漏洞交给任何阅读提交的人"。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 该漏洞直接影响了 KII 和 TAC 代币市场——KiiChain 被盗的代币被抛售为 160 万美元的 BUSD，短暂导致代币价格暴跌。该事件可能提高人们对基于 Cosmos 的链及其对共享模块依赖的关注，并可能影响受影响生态系统的情绪和流动性，但这不构成任何方向性结论。

items.title: Traders start losing control of open positions as BitMEX begins its staged shutdown
items.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright

metadata.title_en: BitMEX Begins Staged Shutdown, Halting New Positions After Aug. 26
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
BitMEX will enter reduce-only mode at 04:00 UTC on Aug. 26, preventing traders from opening new positions, with exchange trading ending Sept. 23 and withdrawal APIs disabled Sept. 28. The staged closure follows a strategic review by owner HDR Global Trading Limited.

BitMEX is one of the longest-standing crypto derivatives exchanges, so its closure removes a major venue for leveraged trading and forces users to close or migrate positions. The orderly wind-down also highlights consolidation and regulatory pressure across crypto derivatives markets.

After Aug. 26, traders may still reduce existing exposure but BitMEX can force-close positions before the mandatory close on Sept. 23. Remaining balances after Sept. 23 incur an annual fee of 1% or $50, whichever is greater, and API withdrawals end Sept. 28, leaving only manual withdrawals of USDT, USDC, and ETH on Ethereum.
metadata.background_en: BitMEX helped popularize perpetual swaps and crypto derivatives but has faced regulatory scrutiny in recent years. Reduce-only mode is a risk-control feature that lets an order close or reduce an existing position without opening a new one, while API withdrawals are programmatic ways for traders and institutions to move funds off an exchange.
metadata.market_impact_en: The closure removes a long-standing derivatives venue and could lead to forced position unwinds and manual stablecoin withdrawals, mainly affecting BTC, ETH, and Ethereum-based USDT/USDC flows. Since the wind-down is orderly rather than insolvency-driven, the market impact is more operational and sentiment-based than systemic.
metadata.title_zh: BitMEX 启动分阶段关闭，8月26日后停止新建仓位
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
BitMEX 将于 8 月 26 日 04:00 UTC 进入 reduce-only（只减仓）模式，交易者无法再开新仓位；交易所交易将于 9 月 23 日结束，9 月 28 日 API 提现功能关闭。此次分阶段关闭是所有者 HDR Global Trading Limited 战略评估后的决定。

BitMEX 是历史最悠久的加密货币衍生品交易所之一，其关闭意味着杠杆交易的一个重要场所消失，用户被迫平仓或迁移仓位。这种有序清盘也反映了加密衍生品行业正在整合并承受监管压力。

8 月 26 日之后，交易者仍可减少现有仓位，但 BitMEX 可能在 9 月 23 日强制平仓之前干预平仓。9 月 23 日后剩余余额将按年收取 1% 或 50 美元中较高者的费用；9 月 28 日 API 提现功能关闭后，用户只能手动提现，且仅支持以太坊上的 USDT、USDC 和 ETH。
metadata.background_zh: BitMEX 曾推动了永续合约和加密衍生品的普及，但近年来一直面临监管审查。Reduce-only（只减仓）模式是一种风险控制功能，允许订单只平仓或减少既有仓位，而不会开立新仓；API 提现则是交易者和机构以程序化方式将资金转出交易所的工具。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 该交易所的关闭移除了一家老牌衍生品平台，可能导致仓位被迫平仓以及手动提取稳定币，主要影响 BTC、ETH 以及基于以太坊的 USDT/USDC 资金流动。由于此次清盘是有序进行而非破产驱动，市场影响更多来自运营层面和情绪面，而非系统性冲击。

items.title: Galaxy puts Coldcard hack losses at 1,789 BTC, with 87% unmoved
items.author: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

metadata.title_en: Galaxy attributes 1,789 BTC losses to Coldcard hack, 87% unmoved
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Galaxy Research has attributed the theft of 1,789.28 Bitcoin from 8,865 addresses to the Coldcard hack, worth $114.7 million at the time of theft. Attackers have not spent 1,561 Bitcoin, or 87.3% of the attributed losses, which remain in attacker-controlled addresses.

This is one of the largest hardware wallet exploits ever documented, and the high percentage of unmoved funds provides a rare opportunity for forensic tracking and potential recovery. The incident may undermine user confidence in hardware wallets and intensify collaboration between exchanges, compliance firms, and law enforcement on blockchain tracing.

The tally partly relies on 221 victim reports covering 790.72 Bitcoin, or 44.2% of the total attributed losses; the median reported loss was 1.04272 Bitcoin, with more than half of reports exceeding 1 Bitcoin. Bitcoin stolen in later attack waves has moved through CoinJoin transactions, peel chains, and other obfuscation methods, while all funds from the first three waves remain unmoved.
metadata.background_en: Coldcard is a Bitcoin-only hardware wallet made by Coinkite since 2017; it protects private keys with secure elements and supports air-gapped signing, which is designed to keep keys offline and safe from remote attacks. CoinJoin is a collaborative Bitcoin transaction method that mixes coins from multiple users into one transaction, making it harder to trace funds; a peel chain is a laundry technique that splits a large amount of cryptocurrency into many small transactions to obscure the trail.
metadata.market_impact_en: The theft involves a large Bitcoin supply that could eventually be liquidated if attackers move the funds, potentially affecting exchange liquidity and market sentiment; however, with 87% of the stolen coins still unmoved, immediate market pressure is limited. Galaxy's sharing of attacker addresses with exchanges and law enforcement could lead to funds being frozen, reducing the likely selling volume.
metadata.title_zh: Galaxy将Coldcard攻击损失归于1789枚比特币，87%未转移
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Galaxy Research将8,865个地址中被盗的1,789.28枚比特币（案发时价值1.147亿美元）归因于Coldcard攻击事件。攻击者尚未动用其中1,561枚比特币（占已认定损失的87.3%），这些资金仍留在攻击者控制的地址中。

这是有记录以来最大的硬件钱包攻击事件之一，高比例的未转移资金为取证追踪和潜在追回提供了罕见机会。该事件可能削弱用户对硬件钱包的信任，并促使交易所、合规机构和执法部门在区块链追踪方面加强合作。

这一统计部分基于221份受害者报告，涵盖790.72枚比特币，占认定总损失的44.2%；报告损失的中位数为1.04272枚比特币，超过一半的报告损失超过1枚比特币。后期攻击波次中盗取的比特币已通过CoinJoin交易、peel chain（剥皮链）和其他混淆手段转移，而前三波攻击盗取的资金均未移动。
metadata.background_zh: Coldcard是Coinkite自2017年起生产的仅支持比特币的硬件钱包，它通过安全元件保护私钥并支持气隙签名，旨在使私钥保持离线以抵御远程攻击。CoinJoin是一种协作式比特币交易方式，将多个用户的币混合到一笔交易中，使资金追踪更加困难；peel chain（剥皮链）是一种洗钱手法，将大量加密货币拆分成许多小额交易以掩盖踪迹。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 该盗窃事件涉及大量比特币供应，如果攻击者最终转移这些资金，可能影响交易所流动性和市场情绪；但由于87%的被盗币仍未移动，当前市场压力有限。Galaxy将攻击者地址分享给交易所和执法部门，可能导致资金被冻结，从而减少潜在的抛售量。

items.title: US Can Now Sanction Anyone Operating in Iran's Crypto Sector
items.author: Decrypt Agent

metadata.title_en: US Expands Sanctions to Anyone Operating in Iran's Crypto Sector
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
On August 24, 2026, the U.S. Treasury's OFAC issued five sectoral determinations under Executive Order 13902, including one covering digital assets, enabling sanctions on any foreign person worldwide operating in or providing services to Iran's digital asset sector. The action, dubbed Operation Economic Outcast, also designated nearly 60 entities, including individuals tied to over $100 million in crypto payments for the IRGC's Qods Force.

This significantly expands the extraterritorial reach of U.S. sanctions, meaning any crypto exchange, payment processor, or service provider worldwide with any Iran-related activity could face designation. It underscores that crypto is increasingly targeted by regulators as a sanctions evasion channel, raising compliance stakes for the entire industry.

The digital asset determination builds on earlier sectoral determinations covering Iran's financial and petroleum sectors, allowing OFAC to designate entities regardless of location. Among the designations, Ivan Obukhov, a UAE-based Ukrainian national, allegedly processed over $100 million in crypto payments facilitating oil sales for the IRGC's Qods Force, and cyber actor Arman Kahzadian was named for seizing a Bitcoin wallet worth over $30,000.
metadata.background_en: Sectoral sanctions are targeted restrictions on specific industries within a sanctioned economy, such as energy, finance, or technology, rather than comprehensive country-wide embargoes. Executive Order 13902, signed in January 2020, initially imposed sanctions on additional sectors of Iran's economy, including construction, mining, manufacturing, and textiles; the new digital assets determination extends that authority. A shadow fleet refers to vessels using concealment tactics to smuggle sanctioned goods, often oil, in response to international sanctions. The U.S. has been increasingly targeting Iranian crypto activity, previously sanctioning exchange Nobitex and firms accepting Bitcoin for safe passage through the Strait of Hormuz.
metadata.market_impact_en: This regulatory action increases compliance and legal risk for crypto businesses worldwide, as any person or entity involved in Iran's digital asset sector may now be sanctioned. The transmission to markets could occur through de-risking by exchanges and service providers with potential Iran exposure, potentially reducing liquidity for certain cross-border crypto flows and heightening geopolitical risk sentiment across digital assets.
metadata.title_zh: 美国：全球任何涉伊朗加密业务者均可被制裁
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
2026年8月24日，美国财政部外国资产控制办公室（OFAC）依据第13902号行政令发布了五项行业认定，其中之一覆盖数字资产，使OFAC可以制裁全球任何在伊朗数字资产领域运营或提供服务的外国人。这项名为“Operation Economic Outcast”的行动还指定了近60个实体，包括涉嫌为伊朗革命卫队“圣城军”处理超过1亿美元加密货币支付的个人。

此举大幅扩大了美国制裁的域外管辖范围，意味着全球任何与伊朗有关联的加密货币交易所、支付处理商或服务提供商都可能面临被指定为制裁对象的风险。这也凸显出加密货币正日益被监管机构视为制裁规避工具，从而使整个行业的合规压力进一步上升。

数字资产行业认定是在此前覆盖伊朗金融和石油行业的认定基础上扩展而来，允许OFAC不分所在地指定相关实体。在被指定对象中，阿联酋乌克兰籍人士Ivan Obukhov涉嫌自2023年起经手超过1亿美元加密货币支付，帮助伊朗革命卫队“圣城军”进行石油销售；网络行为人Arman Kahzadian则因在2023年夏季控制一个价值超3万美元的比特币钱包而被列入指定名单。
metadata.background_zh: 行业制裁是针对受制裁经济体中特定行业（如能源、金融或技术）的定向限制，而非全面的国家禁运。第13902号行政令于2020年1月签署，最初对伊朗经济的建筑、采矿、制造和纺织等额外行业实施制裁，新的数字资产认定进一步扩展了这一权限。“影子船队”指使用隐蔽手段走私受制裁商品（通常是石油）的船只，是对国际制裁的回应。美国此前已加大针对伊朗加密货币活动的打击力度，曾制裁交易所Nobitex，并指定接受比特币以换取安全通过霍尔木兹海峡的公司。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 这项监管行动增加了全球加密业务的合规和法律风险，因为任何涉足伊朗数字资产行业的个人或实体现在都可能受到制裁。对市场的传导可能体现在交易所和服务商对潜在伊朗曝险进行去风险化，从而可能减少某些跨境加密货币流动的流动性，并加剧数字资产市场的地缘政治风险情绪。

items.title: U.S. state banking associations plan to launch their own nationwide blockchain network
items.author: Jesse Hamilton

metadata.title_en: U.S. State Banking Associations Plan Nationwide Blockchain Network
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
On August 25, 2026, 39 U.S. state banking associations announced the BankChain Alliance, an industry-owned nationwide blockchain network targeting a 2027 launch. The alliance has not yet selected a technology partner to build the network.

This marks a major institutional step by the banking industry to build shared blockchain infrastructure, potentially reshaping interbank settlement and payments. If realized, it could accelerate bank adoption of distributed-ledger technology and affect how traditional finance interacts with the broader crypto ecosystem.

The BankChain Alliance says its network will be interoperable with other networks and will invite ownership from banks across the country. The state banking associations collectively represent thousands of financial institutions serving millions of consumers, businesses, and communities nationwide.
metadata.background_en: State banking associations are trade groups that represent banks at the state level and lobby on regulatory and legislative issues. Many banks have been exploring blockchain for faster settlement and tokenized deposits; large global lenders such as JPMorgan, Bank of America, HSBC, Citigroup, and Wells Fargo have been working on a shared network for tokenized bank deposits amid the growth of stablecoins. The BankChain Alliance aims to give institutions of all sizes access to similar capabilities in a regulated, industry-owned environment.
metadata.market_impact_en: If the network reaches launch, it could alter how U.S. banks settle transactions and position the banking industry as a direct participant in blockchain infrastructure, potentially competing with or complementing public-chain settlement and stablecoin ecosystems. The main near-term crypto market channel is sentiment-driven: news of institutional, industry-owned blockchain networks reinforces the adoption narrative for asset tokenization and distributed-ledger technology without creating direct exposure to specific crypto assets.
metadata.title_zh: 美国各州银行协会计划推出全国性区块链网络
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
2026年8月25日，美国39个州银行协会宣布成立BankChain Alliance，计划打造一个行业自有的全国性区块链网络，目标在2027年上线。该联盟目前尚未确定搭建网络的技术合作伙伴。

这标志着银行业在构建共享区块链基础设施方面迈出重大机构化一步，可能重塑银行间结算与支付格局。若计划落地，将加速传统金融机构采用分布式账本技术，并影响传统金融与更广泛加密生态的互动方式。

BankChain Alliance表示，其网络将与其他网络互通，并邀请全美银行参与共同所有权。这些州银行协会合计代表数千家金融机构，服务全美数百万消费者、企业和社区。
metadata.background_zh: 州银行协会是代表各州银行的行业组织，负责就监管和立法事务进行游说。许多银行一直在探索利用区块链实现更快结算和代币化存款；在稳定币增长的背景下，摩根大通、美国银行、汇丰、花旗和富国银行等大型全球银行正合作构建代币化存款共享网络。BankChain Alliance旨在让各种规模的机构都能在受监管、行业自有的环境中获得类似能力。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 如果该网络如期上线，可能改变美国银行的结算方式，使银行业成为区块链基础设施的直接参与者，并与公链结算和稳定币生态形成竞争或互补。短期内对加密市场的主要传导渠道是情绪驱动：机构自建行业区块链网络的消息强化了资产代币化和分布式账本技术的采用叙事，但并不会直接形成对特定加密资产的敞口。

items.title: OpenAI Jalapeño: Better than Nvidia Blackwell
items.author: bmulholland

metadata.title_en: OpenAI's Jalapeño Chip Claims Edge Over Nvidia Blackwell
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
OpenAI's custom inference chip, codenamed Jalapeño and co-designed with Broadcom, reportedly outperforms Nvidia processors in tests, delivering faster and more power-efficient inference for modern large language models. SemiAnalysis published the analysis alongside a Bloomberg report, though the claims are not yet independently verified.

If proven, this could shift the AI infrastructure landscape by giving OpenAI a competitive edge in inference cost and energy efficiency, reducing its dependence on Nvidia GPUs. It also signals a broader trend among hyperscalers toward custom silicon optimized for AI workloads.

Jalapeño is a custom ASIC built specifically for LLM inference, reportedly tied to OpenAI's 10 GW infrastructure commitment through 2029. Community discussion notes that die size appears comparable to Nvidia's Rubin, while NVFP4 PFLOPs are about one-third, and the chip supports low-precision formats like FP4.
metadata.background_en: AI inference hardware is the physical infrastructure used to run trained models on new data for predictions or generation. Nvidia's Blackwell architecture, announced in 2024 and followed by Blackwell Ultra at GTC 2025, powers products like the GB200 superchip and RTX 50-series GPUs, and is a dominant platform for AI compute. OpenAI's move into custom inference silicon reflects a push for specialized, energy-efficient alternatives to general-purpose GPUs.
metadata.community_discussion_en: Commenters compared the emerging inference chip market to the early 3dfx, Riva, and PowerVR era, questioning which players will dominate. Some praised the efficiency gains, noting humans are still 22x more efficient than current chips at speech processing, while others scrutinized FP4 precision trade-offs and apparent discrepancies between the article's text and its comparison table.
metadata.market_impact_en: The story's main crypto market exposure is through AI-themed tokens linked to decentralized GPU and compute networks, which may see sentiment-driven moves as the narrative around custom inference hardware develops. There is no direct regulatory or liquidity channel, and any impact depends on verification and real-world deployment rather than the report alone.
metadata.title_zh: OpenAI 的 Jalapeño 芯片据称性能超越英伟达处理器
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
OpenAI 与博通（Broadcom）联合设计的自研推理芯片“Jalapeño”据称在测试中表现优于英伟达处理器，能以更低功耗为现代大语言模型提供更快、更高效的推理。SemiAnalysis 结合彭博社的报道发布分析，但这些说法尚未得到独立验证。

如果这一说法得到证实，将可能改变 AI 基础设施格局，使 OpenAI 在推理成本和能源效率上获得竞争优势，并减少对英伟达 GPU 的依赖。这也反映出大型科技公司越来越倾向于针对 AI 工作负载优化定制芯片的趋势。

Jalapeño 是一款专为 LLM 推理打造的定制 ASIC，据报道与 OpenAI 到 2029 年 10 GW 的基础设施承诺相关。社区讨论指出，其裸片尺寸与英伟达 Rubin 相当，NVFP4 PFLOPs 约为后者的三分之一，并支持 FP4 等低精度格式。
metadata.background_zh: AI 推理硬件是用于在新的数据上运行已训练模型以进行预测或生成的物理基础设施。英伟达 Blackwell 架构于 2024 年发布，并在 GTC 2025 年推出 Blackwell Ultra，支撑着 GB200 超级芯片和 RTX 50 系列 GPU 等产品，是 AI 计算的主导平台之一。OpenAI 进入定制推理芯片领域，反映出业界正在追求比通用 GPU 更专业、更节能的替代方案。
metadata.community_discussion_zh: 评论者将新兴推理芯片市场比作早期的 3dfx、Riva 和 PowerVR 时代，并探讨最终哪家厂商将占据主导。有人称效率提升显著，指出人类处理语音的效率仍比现有芯片高 22 倍；也有人审视 FP4 精度上的取舍，以及文章正文与对比表格之间明显不一致的地方。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 该事件对加密市场的主要影响渠道在于与去中心化 GPU 和算力网络相关的 AI 主题代币，随着定制推理硬件叙事的发展，这类资产可能出现情绪驱动的波动。由于没有直接的监管或流动性传导链路，任何影响都将取决于实际验证和大规模部署情况，而非仅仅依靠这份报道。

metadata.title_en: Apple Launches Mac Studio with M5 Max and M5 Ultra
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Apple has introduced the new Mac Studio powered by the M5 Max and M5 Ultra chips, with up to 256GB of unified memory and a strong emphasis on on-device AI performance. The M5 Ultra pairs two M5 Max dies via UltraFusion, delivering over 4.4TB/s of inter-die bandwidth.

This release marks Apple's continued push into local AI, giving developers and professionals a high-bandwidth, large-memory machine to run large language models directly on-device. It signals intensifying competition in the local AI compute market and could shift some AI workloads away from cloud infrastructure.

The M5 Ultra is Apple's first quad-die chip, using UltraFusion to interlink two dual-die M5 Max packages, and the Mac Studio offers up to 1.2TB/s of memory bandwidth. It also includes next-generation PCIe Gen 6-based SSDs with up to double the storage performance and Thunderbolt 5 external connectivity at 120Gb/s.
metadata.background_en: Apple Silicon uses a unified memory architecture in which the CPU and GPU share a single pool of memory, eliminating the need to copy data between separate RAM and VRAM. This makes it easier to run large AI models locally because the GPU can access a huge amount of memory directly. The new M5 Ultra extends this approach with a quad-die design, a first for Apple, enabling higher memory capacity and bandwidth. The Mac Studio is Apple's high-end desktop line aimed at professionals.
metadata.community_discussion_en: Community reactions are mixed. Some praise Apple for leaning into local AI and hope for optimized versions of frontier open-weight models for the machine, while others criticize the high price of 256GB memory, note the limited future-proofing for models above 1T parameters, and express concerns about thermal performance of PCIe Gen 6 storage.

此次发布标志着苹果持续加码端侧AI，为开发者和专业人士提供了一台高带宽、大内存的设备，可以直接在本地运行大型语言模型。这表明本地AI计算市场竞争日益激烈，并可能使部分AI工作负载从云端转移至本地。

M5 Ultra是苹果首款四芯片（quad-die）设计，通过UltraFusion连接两颗双芯片M5 Max封装，Mac Studio最高可提供1.2TB/s的内存带宽。它还配备了基于PCIe Gen 6的新一代SSD，存储性能最高可达上一代的两倍，并支持120Gb/s的Thunderbolt 5外部接口。
metadata.background_zh: Apple Silicon采用统一内存架构，CPU和GPU共享同一内存池，无需在独立的内存和显存之间复制数据。这使得在本地运行大型AI模型更加方便，因为GPU可以直接访问超大容量的内存。新款M5 Ultra采用苹果首次的quad-die四芯片设计，进一步扩展了这一思路，使内存容量和带宽更高。Mac Studio是苹果面向专业人群的高端桌面产品线。

metadata.title_en: Qwen Unveils Qwen 3.8-Flash-Next: 125B MoE with 6B Active Parameters
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Qwen announced the upcoming release of Qwen 3.8-Flash-Next, a mixture-of-experts model with 125B total parameters and only 6B active parameters per token. The model is scheduled to be available on ModelScope tomorrow.

The model's extremely low active-parameter ratio (6B) makes it feasible to run on high-memory consumer hardware like 128GB Strix Halo or Mac Studio, potentially bringing frontier-level quality to local inference. This release could accelerate the local AI trend by making competitive models accessible without data-center GPUs.

Qwen 3.8-Flash-Next uses a mixture-of-experts architecture, where a router selects only a small subset of experts per token, drastically cutting compute cost while retaining the knowledge capacity of 125B parameters. The exact context window, license, and benchmark scores have not been disclosed in the announcement.
metadata.background_en: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models split their weights into many specialized 'experts' and activate only a few per token, giving the speed of a small model with the knowledge of a large one. The key distinction is between total parameters (all weights) and active parameters (those actually used for each token), which determines memory and compute requirements respectively. Qwen is a major open-weight AI lab, and its previous models like Qwen 27B have been popular in the local AI community.
metadata.community_discussion_en: Commenters are eagerly anticipating the model, with several noting it finally justifies owning large-memory consumer devices like Strix Halo or the new Mac Studio. Some express frustration with OpenRouter's handling of Qwen models, while others point to inference engines like FreeToken that may improve CPU/RAM+GPU/VRAM distribution for MoE. A few jest about the increasingly convoluted model naming conventions.

该模型极低的激活参数比例（6B）使其能够在128GB Strix Halo或Mac Studio等大内存消费硬件上运行，有望将前沿模型质量带入本地推理。此次发布可能加速本地AI趋势，让竞争性模型无需数据中心GPU即可使用。

Qwen 3.8-Flash-Next采用混合专家架构，路由网络每个token仅调用一小部分专家，在保留125B参数知识容量的同时大幅降低计算成本。公告中未披露具体的上下文窗口、许可证和基准分数。
metadata.background_zh: 混合专家（MoE）模型将权重拆分为多个专门的“专家”，每个token只激活少数几个，从而以小模型的速度获得大模型的知识。关键区别在于总参数（所有权重）和激活参数（每个token实际使用的参数），前者决定内存需求，后者决定计算需求。Qwen是一个重要的开放权重AI实验室，其之前的Qwen 27B等模型在本地AI社区广受欢迎。
metadata.community_discussion_zh: 评论者对这款模型充满期待，有人表示它终于让Strix Halo或新款Mac Studio等大内存消费设备物有所值。一些评论者对OpenRouter上Qwen模型的处理方式表示不满，还有人提到FreeToken等推理引擎可能改善MoE在CPU/RAM与GPU/VRAM间的分配。另有少数人调侃模型命名越来越晦涩难懂。

metadata.title_en: ZRO surges as LayerZero unveils ATLAS exchange infrastructure on Zero blockchain
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
On August 25, 2026, LayerZero announced ATLAS, a headless exchange infrastructure built on its Zero blockchain for trading platforms and financial institutions. The system routes 75% of post-venue trading fees into ZRO buybacks and burns and pays trading venues rebates of up to 65%.

This marks LayerZero's expansion from an interoperability protocol into institutional capital markets infrastructure. ATLAS enables trading venues and financial institutions to operate their own exchanges without building one from scratch, potentially accelerating institutional adoption of Zero blockchain and creating structural demand for ZRO through its buyback-and-burn mechanism.

ATLAS is described as 'headless'—it has no consumer-facing frontend or trading venue of its own; instead it provides matching, clearing, settlement, and risk management as a single integrated system. The platform runs on Zero, a Layer-1 blockchain designed for institutional use, featuring multi-core execution and native interoperability, and backed by firms including Citadel Securities, Ark Invest, DTCC, ICE, and Google Cloud.
metadata.background_en: LayerZero is a widely used interoperability protocol that connects blockchains. Zero, launched by LayerZero, is a new Layer-1 network built around multi-core execution and native interoperability, targeting Wall Street and institutional tokenization with a claimed 2 million transactions per second. In this context, 'headless' infrastructure means backend technology that operates without a user-facing interface, similar to the headless commerce trend in e-commerce.
metadata.market_impact_en: The primary market transmission channel is the ZRO token buyback-and-burn mechanism: trading volume generated on ATLAS-powered venues directly funds ZRO repurchases and burns, while rebates give venues an incentive to use the infrastructure. The announcement also boosts market sentiment around LayerZero's institutional positioning, but no directional price outcome is implied.

ATLAS被称为“无头”系统——它没有面向消费者的前端或自己的交易场所，而是将撮合、清算、结算和风险管理整合为单一系统。该平台运行在Zero上，Zero是专为机构使用设计的Layer 1区块链，具有多核执行和原生互操作性，并得到了包括Citadel Securities、Ark Invest、DTCC、ICE和Google Cloud在内的公司支持。

items.title: Pendle Oracle Move Liquidates $36 Million
items.author: The Defiant Team

metadata.title_en: Pendle Oracle Move Liquidates $36 Million on Morpho
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
A wallet's yield-token purchase in a $9 million Pendle pool pushed the principal token price down 2.8%, triggering the liquidation of $36 million in looped positions on a Morpho market with $52 million in borrows. The incident did not result in any bad debt.

This event illustrates how a relatively small trade in a niche yield-tokenization pool can cascade through interconnected DeFi lending markets, triggering large-scale liquidations. It underscores the systemic risks of oracle-dependent lending and looped positions, affecting participants in Pendle and Morpho ecosystems.

The affected pool was a $9 million Pendle pool, and the Morpho market carried $52 million in borrows; the $36 million in liquidations were cleared without bad debt. The oracle price move was triggered by a single wallet's purchase of yield tokens, highlighting sensitivity of principal-token pricing to relatively small trades.
metadata.background_en: Pendle is a DeFi protocol that tokenizes yield-bearing assets into principal tokens (PT) and yield tokens (YT), enabling users to trade or hedge yield risk. Morpho is an open-source decentralized lending protocol on Ethereum and other EVM chains, where users can supply collateral and borrow assets, sometimes through 'looped' positions that repeatedly deposit and borrow to amplify exposure. Oracle price movements can push leveraged positions below collateral thresholds, triggering liquidations.
metadata.market_impact_en: This liquidation event could affect risk sentiment for DeFi lending and yield-tokenization markets, particularly on Morpho and Pendle. However, since no bad debt resulted, direct protocol losses are absent; the main transmission channel is perceived oracle risk and leveraged-position fragility, which may influence borrowing demand and collateral policies on these platforms.
metadata.title_zh: Pendle预言机变动导致Morpho上3600万美元清算
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
一个钱包在900万美元的Pendle池中购买收益代币，导致本金代币价格下跌2.8%，触发了Morpho市场上一笔5200万美元借款中的3600万美元循环仓位被清算。该事件没有造成任何坏账。

这一事件说明，在一个小众收益代币化池中的相对较小交易，如何通过DeFi借贷市场的相互关联引发大规模清算，最终导致巨额仓位被强平。它凸显了依赖预言机的借贷和循环仓位所蕴含的系统性风险，并影响Pendle和Morpho生态系统的参与者。

受影响的Pendle池规模为900万美元，相关Morpho市场借款总额为5200万美元；3600万美元的清算已完成且未产生坏账。预言机价格变动仅由一个钱包购买收益代币引发，凸显本金代币定价对相对较小交易的敏感性。
metadata.background_zh: Pendle是一种DeFi协议，将产生收益的资产代币化为本金代币（PT）和收益代币（YT），使用户能够交易或对冲收益风险。Morpho是一个在以太坊及其他EVM兼容链上的开源去中心化借贷协议，用户可以提供抵押品并借入资产，有时会通过‘循环’仓位反复存入和借出以放大敞口。预言机价格变动可能将杠杆仓位推至抵押品阈值以下，从而触发清算。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 此次清算事件可能影响DeFi借贷和收益代币化市场的风险情绪，尤其是Morpho和Pendle相关市场。但由于未产生坏账，协议不存在直接损失；主要传导渠道是对预言机风险和杠杆仓位脆弱性的认知，这可能影响这些平台的借贷需求和抵押品政策。

metadata.title_en: Franklin Templeton Tokenized Treasury Fund Lands on HashKey
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
HashKey Exchange has begun distributing Franklin Templeton's Franklin OnChain U.S. Government Liquidity Fund (grBENJI) through its Earn channel, giving professional investors access to a blockchain-wrapped pool of U.S. government debt. The product is available only to professional investors and is not offered to the public in Hong Kong.

This move is significant because it brings a major traditional asset manager's tokenized real-world asset (RWA) product into a regulated Hong Kong exchange, signaling growing institutional acceptance of on-chain Treasury products. It reflects the broader trend of bridging traditional finance and decentralized finance, and could pave the way for more tokenized funds to launch in Asia.

The fund primarily invests in U.S. government money market instruments and dollar cash, with returns tracking short-term Treasury yields, currently around 3.6% with a stable $1 net asset value. Franklin Templeton manages $1.8 trillion in assets and has offered the tokenized fund since 2021; it has also partnered with Kraken, Binance, DigiFT, and MoonPay to expand distribution.
metadata.background_en: Tokenized money market funds are a rapidly growing segment of real-world assets (RWAs), where traditional financial instruments such as U.S. Treasury bills are represented on blockchain networks. Franklin Templeton launched BENJI in 2021, becoming the first U.S.-registered mutual fund to use a public blockchain to record share ownership. HashKey Exchange's Earn channel is a regulated platform that integrates traditional finance with blockchain, previously offering products such as Bosera ETFs. The tokenized money market fund sector has grown to roughly $9 billion in assets, according to recent industry data.
metadata.market_impact_en: The distribution links a $1.8 trillion asset manager's product to a regulated crypto exchange, potentially boosting the credibility and adoption of tokenized RWAs among institutional investors. This could indirectly support demand for RWA infrastructure tokens and increase traffic to compliant exchanges like HashKey, though the effect on crypto asset prices is indirect and uncertain.

metadata.title_en: Court Lets Coinbase Investor Class Action Over Bankruptcy Disclosures Proceed

A U.S. federal judge ruled that a Coinbase investor class action may proceed, rejecting the exchange's attempt to dismiss claims that it inadequately disclosed bankruptcy risks. The ruling is procedural and does not decide the merits of the investors' allegations.

The decision could pressure crypto exchanges to more clearly disclose how customer assets would be treated in a bankruptcy, a concern that intensified after the collapses of FTX and other crypto platforms. It also underscores the legal exposure of major U.S. exchanges to securities class actions over their disclosures.

The class action survived the motion-to-dismiss stage, meaning the court found the plaintiffs' claims legally plausible enough to continue toward discovery. As this is an early-stage ruling, the final outcome could still take years to resolve.
metadata.background_en: In the crypto industry, customer assets held by exchanges have faced legal uncertainty in insolvency proceedings, highlighted by the failures of Celsius, Voyager, and FTX. U.S. securities law requires public companies to disclose material risks, and investor class actions are a common mechanism for challenging allegedly misleading statements. This case tests how those disclosure obligations apply to bankruptcy risks at crypto exchanges, and the ruling allows the litigation to advance beyond the pleading stage.
metadata.market_impact_en: The ruling transmits to markets mainly through the legal and regulatory channel: it raises the prospect of higher litigation and compliance costs for Coinbase and contributes to the disclosure-risk narrative for U.S. crypto exchanges. Because it is a procedural decision rather than a final judgment, its direct and immediate market transmission is limited, though it may influence sentiment on Coinbase stock and exchange-related tokens over time.

dedup_history.title: Zilliqa points to hardware wallet flaw discarding entropy to expose crypto keys, enabling 683M ZIL theft
dedup_history.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright

metadata.title_en: Zilliqa: Ledger Bug Exposed 6,772 Keys, Enabled 683M ZIL Theft
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Zilliqa's post-mortem reveals a bug in the legacy Ledger application for Zilliqa discarded eight bytes of entropy when generating nonces, exposing the private keys of at least 6,772 accounts and enabling the theft of 683,130,969.66 ZIL across 66 transactions. Legacy transactions remain paused while migration to Zilliqa EVM awaits an external security audit.

This confirmed hardware-wallet security failure directly compromises user funds, and since already-published signatures cannot be withdrawn, exposed keys remain at risk permanently. It highlights how a subtle randomness bug in a signing implementation can undermine the security guarantees hardware wallets are trusted to provide, affecting ZIL holders using the legacy Ledger app and broader confidence in such devices.

The application generated 40 random bytes per nonce but copied the wrong 32 bytes into the signing buffer, keeping eight zero bytes and discarding eight entropy bytes, forcing the high 64 bits of each affected nonce to zero. Four or more such biased signatures for the same account allow private-key recovery in seconds from public blockchain data; the bulk scan required five signatures, so accounts with exactly four were not counted in the 6,772 figure.
metadata.background_en: ECDSA is an elliptic-curve digital signature scheme used by many blockchains; its security relies on the nonce (a random number used once) being unpredictable and unique. If the nonce is biased, an attacker who collects enough signatures can solve for the private key mathematically. This Zilliqa incident is similar in kind to the 2021 COLDCARD entropy failure, where a firmware migration caused the wallet to fall back to a deterministic software RNG, dramatically reducing seed entropy. Zilliqa is a blockchain that launched with its own native transaction format and is in the process of migrating to Zilliqa EVM, an Ethereum-compatible environment, which the team says is unaffected by this bug.
metadata.market_impact_en: The affected asset is ZIL itself, so the transmission channel runs through on-chain liquidity and exchange operations: legacy transactions remain paused, deposits and withdrawals tied to the legacy path may be disrupted, and the confirmed compromise of thousands of keys could weigh on user confidence. Broader market impact is likely limited because ZIL is a relatively small-cap asset and the disclosed bug is confined to Zilliqa's legacy Ledger signing path, not the EVM side.
metadata.title_zh: Zilliqa 指 Ledger 漏洞泄露密钥，致 6.83 亿 ZIL 被盗
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Zilliqa 的事后调查报告显示，旧版 Ledger 应用程序在生成 nonce 时丢弃了 8 字节熵，导致至少 6,772 个账户的私钥暴露，并使 66 笔交易中被盗 683,130,969.66 ZIL。旧版交易仍处于暂停状态，迁移到 Zilliqa EVM 需要等待外部安全审计。

这次已确认的硬件钱包安全故障直接危及用户资金，而已发布的签名无法撤销，因此已暴露的密钥将永久面临风险。它凸显了签名实现中一个微小的随机性漏洞，足以破坏硬件钱包被广泛信赖的安全保障，影响使用旧版 Ledger 应用的 ZIL 持有者，并可能削弱对这类设备的整体信心。

该应用为每个 nonce 生成 40 个随机字节，但将错误的 32 字节复制到签名缓冲区，保留了 8 个零字节并丢弃 8 个熵字节，导致受影响 nonce 的高 64 位被强制设为零。同一账户产生四个或更多此类有偏签名后，攻击者可在数秒内从公开链上数据恢复私钥；批量扫描要求至少五个签名，因此恰好四个签名的账户未被计入 6,772 这个数字。
metadata.background_zh: ECDSA 是一种椭圆曲线数字签名算法，被许多区块链使用，其安全性依赖于 nonce（一次性随机数）的不可预测性和唯一性。如果 nonce 存在偏差，攻击者收集足够多的签名后，就可以通过数学运算求出私钥。本次 Zilliqa 事件与 2021 年 COLDCARD 熵失效事故类似——那次固件迁移导致钱包回退到确定性软件随机数生成器，使种子熵大幅降低。Zilliqa 是一个区块链网络，最初使用自有原生交易格式，目前正在迁移到 Zilliqa EVM（兼容以太坊的环境），团队表示该环境不受此漏洞影响。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 受影响资产正是 ZIL 本身，因此传导渠道主要来自链上流动性和交易所操作：旧版交易仍暂停，依赖旧版路径的充提可能受阻，且数千个密钥被确认暴露可能影响用户信心。更广泛的市场影响可能有限，因为 ZIL 市值相对较小，且该漏洞仅限于 Zilliqa 旧版 Ledger 签名路径，而非 EVM 侧。

dedup_history.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright

metadata.title_en: BounceBit Retires Layer 1, Reissues BB on BNB Chain After Authorization Flaw
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
BounceBit is retiring its standalone Layer 1 and will reissue BB tokens 1:1 on BNB Chain based on an Aug. 19 snapshot, after an authorization flaw enabled the movement of about 286.5 million BB from nine accounts. The new token's gas, staking, rewards, and governance roles have not yet been defined.

This incident shows how protocol-level flaws can force a chain to shut down, leaving token holders exposed to undefined token utility during migration. It also highlights the risks of inherited code from stacks like Evmos and the difficulty of preserving token value across network transitions.

The cutoff is block 20,697,260 at 21:02:35 UTC on Aug. 19; balances below 10 BB will be handled via a later claim portal. The new BEP-20 contract is deployed but its address is withheld until exchange due diligence completes, and the old chain will not be restarted.
metadata.background_en: BounceBit is an EVM-compatible Layer 1 blockchain that pioneered Bitcoin restaking and used a dual-token proof-of-stake model with BTC and its native BB token. The chain, built on an Evmos-derived stack, previously gave BB roles such as gas, staking and validator rewards, platform currency, and governance. The authorization flaw allowed a caller to designate another account as the funding source without approval, compromising 286.5 million BB without exposing private keys.
metadata.market_impact_en: The migration to BNB Chain creates an immediate custody and liquidity channel: BB holders must rely on the new BEP-20 contract, and exchange-dependent users face suspended trading until venues restart. Since the old chain is retired, BB's value now hinges on undefined future utility and BNB Chain ecosystem integration, which could affect market sentiment and secondary-market liquidity for the token.
metadata.title_zh: BounceBit因授权漏洞关闭L1，在BNB链上1:1重发BB代币
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:

这一事件表明，协议级漏洞可能迫使链关闭，使代币持有人在迁移期间面临代币用途不明的情况。它也凸显了从 Evmos 等堆栈继承代码的风险，以及跨网络迁移时保留代币价值的难度。

快照截止点为 8 月 19 日 21:02:35 UTC 的区块 20,697,260；低于 10 BB 的余额将通过后续领取门户处理。新的 BEP-20 合约已部署，但为配合交易所尽职调查暂不公布地址，旧链不会重启。
metadata.background_zh: BounceBit 是一个兼容 EVM 的 Layer 1 区块链，率先推出比特币再质押，并采用 BTC 与原生代币 BB 的双代币权益证明机制。该链基于 Evmos 衍生堆栈构建，此前 BB 承担 gas、质押与验证者奖励、平台货币和治理等功能。授权漏洞使调用者无需批准即可将另一账户指定为资金来源，导致 2.865 亿枚 BB 受影响，但私钥、签名和钱包均未被入侵。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 迁移至 BNB Chain 形成了直接的托管与流动性渠道：BB 持有者须依赖新的 BEP-20 合约，依赖交易所的用户在场所恢复交易前将面临暂停。由于旧链退役，BB 的价值现在取决于尚未明确的未来用途及 BNB Chain 生态整合，这可能影响该代币的市场情绪和二级市场流动性。

metadata.title_en: Zondacrypto CEO seeks leniency in fraud case, report says
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Przemysław Kral, head of collapsed cryptocurrency exchange Zondacrypto, has been charged with participating in an alleged large-scale fraud and is cooperating with Polish prosecutors to seek a reduced sentence. His testimony may include details about Zondacrypto's funding of right-wing politicians, according to Polish outlet Onet.

This case highlights the risks of centralized exchanges mishandling customer funds, with estimated customer losses of $650 million. The potential political dimension could expand the scandal beyond crypto, affecting regulatory and political conversations in Poland and beyond.

Prosecutors estimate customers lost at least 2.4 billion Polish zlotys ($650 million), alleging only part of customer funds was used to buy crypto while the rest was transferred to managers' private accounts. Kral denies misappropriation, saying the missing Bitcoin was held in a cold wallet whose private keys were supposed to be with former CEO Sylwester Suszek, who has been missing since 2022.
metadata.background_en: Zondacrypto, formerly BitBay, was founded in Poland in 2014 by Sylwester Suszek and grew into one of the largest cryptocurrency exchanges in Central and Eastern Europe. Suszek disappeared in 2022, and the exchange later went offline, leaving client assets stranded. Kral disclosed in mid-April that the exchange could not access a cold wallet holding about 4,500 Bitcoin and has since remained silent on social media. The exchange was a major sponsor of CPAC Poland and spent 37 million zlotys on advertising with broadcaster Telewizja Republika in its final year.
metadata.market_impact_en: The collapse and fraud charges could further erode trust in centralized exchanges, especially in Central and Eastern Europe, potentially pushing users toward self-custody or more regulated platforms. Regulatory scrutiny of exchange political donations and custody practices may intensify, affecting how exchanges operate in the region; the direct impact on token prices is likely limited to sentiment-driven moves in assets associated with the exchange.

metadata.title_en: Ethereum DeFi Protocol Term Finance Hit by Governance Exploit Draining Millions
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Term Finance, an Ethereum-based fixed-rate DeFi lending protocol, suffered a governance exploit that drained millions of dollars from its vaults. The incident is a major security setback that directly affects user funds.

The exploit directly exposes the risks of decentralized governance and smart-contract security in DeFi lending. It could shake user confidence in noncustodial fixed-rate lending protocols and underscore the importance of robust governance safeguards across the ecosystem.

dedup_history.title: SeL4 security proofs now complete on AArch64
dedup_history.author: snvzz

metadata.title_en: seL4 Security Proofs Complete on AArch64
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
The seL4 microkernel's formal security proofs have been completed on the AArch64 (64-bit ARM) architecture, extending its verified correctness and security guarantees to this widely used platform. This marks a significant formal verification milestone for the microkernel.

AArch64 is the dominant architecture for mobile, embedded, and increasingly server systems, so proving seL4's security properties on this platform can enable high-assurance deployments in safety-critical industries such as automotive, avionics, and defense. It also demonstrates that large-scale formal verification is becoming practical for real-world production kernels.

The completed proofs cover seL4's security properties on AArch64, but community comments note that they currently exclude MCS (mixed criticality system) extensions and are limited to unicore (single-core) configurations. The verification is a machine-code-level proof, yet side-channel timing attacks are not covered by the result.
metadata.background_en: seL4 is an open-source microkernel developed by NICTA (now CSIRO's Data61) and the Trustworthy Systems group, and it was the first operating-system kernel with a formal proof of functional correctness. Formal verification uses mathematical techniques to prove that a system's implementation satisfies its specification, eliminating entire classes of implementation bugs. AArch64 is the 64-bit execution state of the ARM architecture, which powers the vast majority of smartphones and many embedded and server systems. Completing these proofs on AArch64 required formalizing the architecture's behavior and the kernel's compiled machine code, a large and complex engineering effort.
metadata.community_discussion_en: The comments reflect a mix of skepticism and practical curiosity. One user jokingly predicts a side-channel timing attack that will invalidate the result, while another points out the proof's fine print limits it to non-MCS, unicore configurations. Others discuss real-world seL4 deployments (such as GenodeOS, LionsOS, and a Chinese car maker's hypervisor) and argue that seL4 needs native Linux compatibility to convincingly improve system security.

metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
seL4微内核的正式安全证明已在AArch64（64位ARM）架构上完成，将其经验证的正确性和安全保证扩展到这一广泛使用的平台。这标志着该微内核在形式化验证方面的一个重要里程碑。

AArch64是移动、嵌入式以及日益增长的服务器系统的主导架构，因此在该平台上证明seL4的安全属性，可推动汽车、航空电子和国防等安全关键行业的高保障部署。这也表明大规模形式化验证对实际生产级内核正变得切实可行。

已完成的证明涵盖了seL4在AArch64上的安全属性，但社区评论指出，目前这些证明不包括MCS（混合关键性系统）扩展，且仅限于单核配置。该验证是机器码级别的证明，但旁道时序攻击并不在此结果的覆盖范围内。
metadata.background_zh: seL4是一个由NICTA（现为CSIRO的Data61）和Trustworthy Systems小组开发的开源微内核，它是第一个具有功能正确性形式化证明的操作系统内核。形式化验证利用数学方法证明系统的实现满足其规格，从而消除整类实现错误。AArch64是ARM架构的64位执行状态，驱动着绝大多数智能手机以及许多嵌入式和服务端系统。在AArch64上完成这些证明，需要将架构行为和内核的编译后机器码加以形式化，是一项庞大而复杂的工程。
metadata.community_discussion_zh: 评论既表现出怀疑，也有实际的兴趣。一位用户戏称即将出现一种侧信道时序攻击来彻底否定该结果，另一位则指出证明的细则将其限制在非MCS、单核配置。还有人讨论seL4的实际部署（如GenodeOS、LionsOS以及一家中国汽车制造商用作虚拟机监控程序），并认为seL4需要原生的Linux兼容性才能令人信服地提升系统安全性。

Reports indicate the attack did not break the protocol's code; the attacker instead gained governance control and drained vaults holding Ethereum and stablecoins. The protocol's safeguards, including a seven-day delay on vault proposals and a liquidity provider veto, failed to stop the exploit.
metadata.background_en: Term Finance is a noncustodial fixed-rate lending protocol that uses on-chain auctions to match borrowers and lenders on Ethereum. In DeFi, governance systems allow token holders to vote on protocol changes; if an attacker gains control of governance, they can manipulate the system without exploiting code bugs. The incident occurred on August 23, 2026, and resulted in the loss of roughly $8.5 million in Ethereum and stablecoins from vaults.
metadata.market_impact_en: The exploit exposes governance risk in DeFi lending, which could affect sentiment toward similar protocols and their governance tokens. Direct losses of roughly $8.5 million may pressure Term Finance's vaults and associated tokens, but the broader market impact depends on contagion and investor confidence.

metadata.detailed_summary_zh: Term Finance（又称 Term Labs）是一个基于以太坊的非托管固定利率借贷协议，2026 年 8 月 23 日，攻击者控制其治理系统并盗走多个金库中的资金，估计损失约 850 万美元。尽管协议设有七天的提案延迟和流动性提供者否决机制，攻击仍然得逞。 这一事件表明，在 DeFi 中，治理控制（而不仅仅是代码漏洞）是关键的受攻击面。它还引发人们的担忧：当治理系统被攻破时，延迟和否决等保护措施是否足以保障用户资金安全。 报道称，本次攻击并未破坏协议代码，攻击者是通过获取治理控制权来盗取金库中的以太坊和稳定币。该协议原有的安全机制——包括金库提案的七天延迟和流动性提供者否决权——都未能阻止这次攻击。
metadata.background_zh: Term Finance 是一个非托管固定利率借贷协议，利用链上拍卖在以太坊上撮合借款人和出借人。在 DeFi 中，治理系统允许代币持有者对协议变更进行投票；一旦攻击者控制了治理权限，就可以在不利用代码漏洞的情况下操纵系统。该事件发生在 2026 年 8 月 23 日，导致金库中约 850 万美元的以太坊和稳定币被盗。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 此次攻击暴露了 DeFi 借贷中的治理风险，可能会影响市场对类似协议及其治理代币的情绪。约 850 万美元的直接损失可能会给 Term Finance 的金库及相关代币带来压力，但其对更广泛市场的影响取决于风险传染和投资者信心。

metadata.title_en: CFTC and Soldier Spar Over Polymarket Bet Regulation
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
The US Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) is asking to file an amicus brief in the criminal insider-trading case against Army soldier Gannon Ken Van Dyke, who allegedly made over $400,000 trading Polymarket event contracts using nonpublic information. Van Dyke's defense attorneys oppose the move, calling the regulator a 'regulatory wolf' seeking to advance its own interests through the back door.

This case puts the legal status of prediction-market event contracts under the spotlight, specifically whether they count as 'swaps' within CFTC jurisdiction. The outcome could influence how US regulators oversee platforms such as Polymarket and Kalshi, affecting their compliance burdens and access for US users.

The CFTC's separate civil case against Van Dyke was stayed pending the criminal proceeding, and he has pleaded not guilty; a trial may begin in late 2026 or early 2027. The CFTC is also running an Advance Notice of Proposed Rulemaking on event contracts, with public comments due by April 30, 2026.
metadata.background_en: Polymarket is a crypto-based prediction market where users buy and sell event contracts tied to real-world outcomes, from elections to military conflicts. The CFTC has long debated whether such contracts fall under its authority or constitute swaps, and recently issued a framework proposal aimed at addressing manipulation and asymmetric information. In a related move, a court recently ordered Kalshi to stop offering a broad range of prediction markets in Washington.
metadata.market_impact_en: The regulatory fight centers on whether Polymarket's event contracts are swaps, a classification that would put them under CFTC oversight and could raise compliance costs or restrict US access to prediction market platforms. Market participants exposed to these platforms—and to the crypto tokens used for settlement—could face regulatory-driven changes in liquidity and availability, though the trajectory depends on court rulings and rulemaking.
metadata.title_zh: CFTC与士兵就Polymarket投注监管问题交锋
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）正在申请在针对陆军士兵Gannon Ken Van Dyke的刑事内幕交易案中提交法庭之友意见书，后者被指控利用非公开信息在Polymarket上交易事件合约获利超过40万美元。Van Dyke的辩护律师反对此举，称该监管机构是'监管之狼'，试图通过后门维护自身利益。

此案将预测市场事件合约的法律地位推上风口浪尖，特别是其是否属于CFTC管辖范围内的'掉期'（swaps）。裁决结果可能影响美国监管机构如何监督Polymarket和Kalshi等平台，进而影响其合规负担和美国用户的可及性。

CFTC对Van Dyke的独立民事案件已被暂缓，等待刑事诉讼结果；他已作无罪抗辩，审判可能在2026年底或2027年初开始。CFTC还就事件合约发布了一份拟议规则制定的预先通知，公众评论截止日期为2026年4月30日。
metadata.background_zh: Polymarket是一个基于加密货币的预测市场，用户可就选举、军事冲突等现实世界结果买卖事件合约。CFTC长期以来一直在争论此类合约是否属于其监管范围或构成掉期，并最近发布了旨在应对操纵和信息不对称问题的框架提案。此外，法院近期命令Kalshi停止在华盛顿提供一系列广泛的预测市场。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 这场监管争论的核心在于Polymarket的事件合约是否属于掉期，若被归类为掉期，将使其纳入CFTC监管，并可能提高合规成本或限制美国用户对预测市场平台的访问。涉及这些平台及其结算所用加密代币的市场参与者，可能面临由监管驱动的流动性和可用性变化，但具体走向取决于法院裁决和规则制定。

metadata.title_en: Coinbase Launches Tokenized Stocks for Nvidia, Apple, Meta, Alphabet on Base
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Coinbase launched tokenized stocks for Nvidia, Apple, Meta, and Alphabet on its Base layer-2 network, available to non-US users. Approximately $4.5 million was minted and $3 million of DEX liquidity appeared on day one.

A major US exchange bringing tokenized equities of well-known tech companies onto a public layer-2 network marks a significant step for on-chain securities. This development could broaden access for non-US investors and test regulatory and market-structure boundaries in the crypto ecosystem.

Chainlink price feeds run 24/5 while the tokenized stocks trade 24/7, creating a potential gap in reference pricing. Base is an Ethereum rollup incubated by Coinbase, processing transactions on its own execution layer while settling through Ethereum.
metadata.background_en: Tokenized stocks are blockchain-based tokens that reflect the value of a specific equity, typically issued by creating a token that is backed by real-world shares. Base is an Ethereum Layer 2 network originally incubated by Coinbase, which works by rolling up many transactions off-chain and submitting them to Ethereum in batches. Chainlink price feeds provide external market data used by on-chain protocols to reference real-world asset prices.
metadata.market_impact_en: The launch creates a new channel for on-chain demand for synthetic exposure to major US tech equities, likely affecting Base-native DEXs through liquidity flows and the tokenized stock tokens themselves. The reliance on Chainlink price feeds also ties these markets to Chainlink's oracle infrastructure, though no directional price outcome is implied.
metadata.title_zh: Coinbase在Base上推出英伟达、苹果、Meta和Alphabet代币化股票
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Coinbase在其Base二层网络上为英伟达、苹果、Meta和Alphabet推出了代币化股票，面向非美国用户开放。上线首日铸造了约450万美元的资产，并出现了约300万美元的DEX流动性。

美国主要交易所将知名科技公司的代币化股票引入公共二层网络，标志着链上证券领域迈出了重要一步。这一进展可能为非美国投资者拓宽准入渠道，并考验加密生态中的监管与市场结构边界。

Chainlink价格源每周运行5天、每天24小时，而代币化股票则每周7天、每天24小时交易，这可能在参考定价上产生间隙。Base是Coinbase孵化的以太坊rollup网络，在自身执行层处理交易，并通过以太坊完成结算。
metadata.background_zh: 代币化股票是一种基于区块链的代币，反映特定股票的价值，通常通过发行由现实世界股票支持的代币来创建。Base是Coinbase最初孵化的以太坊二层网络，其原理是在链下汇总大量交易，并以批量方式提交到以太坊主链。Chainlink价格源为链上协议提供外部市场数据，用于参考现实世界资产的价格。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 此次发布为链上对主要美国科技股合成敞口的需求创造了新渠道，可能通过流动性流动影响Base原生DEX及代币化股票代币本身。这些市场对Chainlink价格源的依赖也将它们与Chainlink的预言机基础设施联系起来，但并不意味着任何方向性的价格结果。

metadata.title_en: Coinbase launches tokenized US stocks on Base with Chainlink price feeds
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Coinbase has launched tokenized US stocks as B20 tokens natively on its Base layer-2 blockchain, with Chainlink Data Feeds providing continuous pricing for equities including Nvidia, Apple, Meta and Alphabet.

The official launch from a major US exchange brings US equities into DeFi on Base, expanding 24/7 trading access for eligible non-US users and bridging traditional finance with blockchain liquidity.

Each B20 token represents a direct claim on an underlying share held by regulated broker and custodian Alpaca under an Abu Dhabi Global Market-supervised structure. Chainlink's feeds value each token using the underlying stock price plus a Coinbase-supplied multiplier that accounts for dividends and corporate actions, and Base says more tokenized stocks are planned in the coming weeks.
metadata.background_en: Tokenized stocks are traditional securities represented as blockchain tokens, enabling them to be traded onchain and used in DeFi. Base is a layer-2 blockchain built by Coinbase using the OP Stack, settling on Ethereum, and Chainlink Data Feeds aggregate price data from multiple sources via a decentralized network of node operators. According to RWA.xyz, the total value of tokenized stocks is around $2.48 billion, up 5.2% over the past 30 days, with monthly transfer volume reaching $27.28 billion and over 2.1 million holders.
metadata.market_impact_en: The launch could increase onchain trading activity and demand for Chainlink data services on Base, while broadening the RWA market beyond crypto-native assets. Its actual impact on crypto markets will depend on user adoption, regulatory developments, and how much capital flows into Base-based DeFi protocols such as Aave.
metadata.title_zh: Coinbase在Base上线代币化美股，采用Chainlink价格数据
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Coinbase已在其Base Layer-2区块链上原生推出代币化美股（B20代币），Chainlink Data Feeds为英伟达、苹果、Meta和Alphabet等股票提供持续定价。

此次由美国主流交易所正式推出，将美股带入Base生态的DeFi领域，为符合条件的非美国用户提供全天候交易渠道，并打通传统金融与链上流动性。

每个B20代币代表对由受监管经纪商与托管商Alpaca持有的标的股票的直接索取权，该结构受阿布扎比全球市场（ADGM）监管。Chainlink的喂价采用标的价格加上Coinbase提供的乘数（考虑股息和公司行动）来估值；Base表示未来几周还将上线更多代币化股票。
metadata.background_zh: 代币化股票是将传统证券以区块链代币形式表示，使其可以在链上交易并用于DeFi。Base是Coinbase基于OP Stack构建的Layer-2区块链，最终在以太坊上结算，而Chainlink Data Feeds通过去中心化节点运营商网络聚合多个来源的价格数据。根据RWA.xyz的数据，代币化股票总市值约为24.8亿美元，过去30天上涨5.2%，月度转账量达272.8亿美元，持有者超过210万。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 此次发布可能提升Base上的链上交易活动以及对Chainlink数据服务的需求，同时将RWA市场从加密原生资产进一步拓宽。其对加密市场的实际影响将取决于用户采用、监管进展以及资金流入Aave等Base生态DeFi协议的情况。

metadata.title_en: Coinbase Launches Tokenized Stocks on Base Network
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Coinbase has debuted tokenized stocks on its Base network, joining the race to bring equities on-chain. The move makes traditional stock exposure available as blockchain-based tokens on Base.

As a leading US exchange, Coinbase's entry validates tokenized equities as a mainstream market structure and could accelerate institutional adoption. It also strengthens Base's position as a hub for real-world asset (RWA) tokenization.

Tokenized stocks are blockchain-based digital assets designed to represent economic exposure to traditional shares, and on Base they are traded as tokens. Base is an Ethereum Layer 2 network built on the OP Stack and incubated by Coinbase, offering low-cost, developer-friendly on-chain access.
metadata.background_en: Tokenized stocks are part of the broader real-world asset (RWA) tokenization trend, in which ownership rights in traditional financial assets are converted into blockchain-based tokens. Base is an Ethereum Layer 2 built on the OP Stack in collaboration with Optimism, with Coinbase aiming to make onchain the next online. This launch puts Coinbase in competition with other platforms that already offer tokenized equities.
metadata.market_impact_en: By bringing tokenized equities onto Base, Coinbase connects traditional stock trading with crypto market infrastructure, potentially increasing on-chain trading volumes and liquidity in the Base ecosystem and the broader RWA tokenization segment. The move could also shape regulatory and custody expectations for tokenized securities in the US.
metadata.title_zh: Coinbase在Base网络上推出代币化股票

作为美国头部交易所，Coinbase的入场验证了代币化股票作为主流市场结构的可行性，并可能加速机构采用。这也巩固了Base作为现实世界资产（RWA）代币化中心的地位。

代币化股票是基于区块链的数字资产，旨在代表对传统股票的经济敞口，在Base上以代币形式交易。Base是Coinbase孵化的以太坊Layer 2网络，基于OP Stack构建，提供低成本、对开发者友好的链上接入。
metadata.background_zh: 代币化股票是更广泛的现实世界资产（RWA）代币化趋势的一部分，即将传统金融资产的所有权转换为基于区块链的代币。Base是与Optimism合作、基于OP Stack构建的以太坊Layer 2网络，Coinbase的目标是让链上成为下一个在线形态。此次发布使Coinbase加入了已经提供代币化股票的其他平台之间的竞争。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 通过在Base上推出代币化股票，Coinbase将传统股票交易与加密市场基础设施连接起来，可能提升Base生态及更广泛RWA代币化板块的链上交易量和流动性。此举还可能影响美国对代币化证券的监管与托管预期。
